name: What is the typical process for a major renovation project following smoke damage?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a major renovation project following smoke damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our managed process begins after initial smoke damage mitigation and cleanup are complete. We start with a consultation to understand your vision, followed by detailed design planning, including CAD-supported layouts. We then handle permit coordination, material selection, and execute the construction with clear communication throughout. This integrated design-build approach ensures a seamless transformation, from concept to final walkthrough, rebuilding your home to an elevated standard.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process for post-damage renovation involves initial consultation, design planning, permit coordination, material selection, and construction, managed seamlessly from start to finish.
